Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Requesting starter credits for SparkLift prototype

Hi Redwood team —

We just spun up a trial account (SparkLift) and completed the self-serve signup form earlier today. We’re a two-person ML/dev team building a docs search + summarization feature that will heavily hit embeddings and short-response generation in the first 2–3 weeks.

We’re hoping to request a small starter credit to get through our initial eval: roughly $500 in credits to accelerate testing (mainly embeddings and some streaming chat). Quick details:
- Company: SparkLift (seed-stage, YC W21)
- Use-case: vector search + conversational UI for internal docs (no PII)
- Expected monthly tokens (trial): ~10M embedding tokens + small generation volume
- Compliance: SOC2 not required for prototype; will be in sandbox environment

Attached the signup payload (JSON) from the self-serve form for reference.

Can you confirm whether this qualifies for a starter grant and what the typical turnaround is? We’re trying to demo to a pilot customer next Thursday.

Thanks —
Jules Martin
Head of Product, SparkLift
jules@sparklift.ai

Attachment: signup_payload.json (form submission)

Hi Jules —

Thanks for the details and for filling out the form — appreciate the context. Quick answers:
- $500 starter credits is within our standard PLG promo range for early evals.
- Typical turnaround is same-day to 48 hours depending on volume of requests and any additional verification needed.

Two quick clarifying questions to help expedite approvals: 1) Is SparkLift using a single account/org or separate project accounts for internal vs external demos? 2) Do you expect to store any user-produced content from the pilot outside your controlled sandbox?

I’ll loop in Marissa from Growth for approval and to start the issuance flow (if approved we’ll add the credit to your org and send a short receipt). In parallel, here’s our internal PLG credit policy link so you know the usual constraints: https://docs.redwood.ai/internal/plg-credit-policy-v2

Best,
